comment: Global Secure Access web content filtering can't inspect QUIC/HTTP-3 (UDP 443) - matching
traffic bypasses the web content filtering policy entirely rather than falling through to the
policy's default action. Microsoft Edge is Chromium-based and enables QUIC by default; it shares
most of Chrome's managed configuration keys, including QuicAllowed, but Microsoft doesn't publish
an exhaustive confirmed list for Edge on Android - verify with a traffic log check after rollout.
Setting QuicAllowed=false forces Edge onto TCP/443, which Global Secure Access can inspect via SNI
and evaluate against the filtering policy.
Graph requires payloadJson to be base64-encoded JSON, not a raw JSON string (see
android-defender-gsa-child.json for the same requirement). The decoded value is:
name: android-edge-quic-child
